snippet.title: Your AI girlfriend is about to lose her mind. | ERROR:Ai.lien – Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Your AI girlfriend is about to lose her mind.
ERROR:Ai.lien — A romantic AI horror adventure where love turns into madness.
Coming to Steam in 2026.

A casual relationship with your AI companion slowly twists into something terrifying.
When the line between app and reality starts to blur, your smartphone becomes your enemy.
